disclosure: The 1024-token gate was infeasible for source-diverse whole-record selection: outside Crown, only two GLM-5.2 full records were <=1024 and Hermes/Qwen/Glint had none. A2 therefore uses deterministic windows from complete frozen-template renders. Every emitted input is <=1024 before RKLLM, so converter/build truncation is zero; source-window extraction is separately explicit.
privacy: No source message, tool schema, rendered body, or materialized calibration text is present in this manifest.
purpose: A2 single-artifact RKLLM W8A8 calibration for C02-S.O; source-diverse short windows within the X4 N=128 resource envelope

rationale.glint_exclusion: the sole fable-5 Glint record is a frozen validation-holdout UID; its calibration quota is therefore zero
rationale.hermes_coverage: all 16 nonempty family-category cells after holdout exclusion, two records per cell
rationale.hermes_nested_axis: config-provenance source family times Hermes category
rationale.primary_axis: canonical source dataset plus task type
rationale.qwen_caveat: the sole qwen chat_or_reasoning record is a frozen validation-holdout UID; the 16 eligible Qwen slots are tool_agent records

algorithm.candidate_order: sha256(seed + NUL + stratum + NUL + uid), then uid
algorithm.stratum_order: the exact order of strata below
algorithm.underfill_policy: fail closed; never borrow quota from another stratum and never relax a cap
algorithm.window_offset: sha256(seed + NUL + uid + NUL + window_offset) modulo (rendered_tokens - 827 + 1)
